ModMetaData.name: RimDoc+ Probe
ModMetaData.author: w1ck3ds0d4
ModMetaData.description:
Measures what each mod costs per tick, and reports that a running game is still ticking.
Installed by RimDoc+, and removable from it. Everything else RimDoc+ does is measured from outside the game, which is why it knows load time and memory and cannot know simulation time. This is the part that has to be inside.
It times the tick methods that mods declare, adds up the time per mod, and writes the result to Config/../RimDoc/probe.json every five seconds. It changes nothing about your game: no defs, no saves, no behaviour. It only measures.
The report is also a heartbeat. From outside the process a crash an hour into a colony looks exactly like a healthy boot, and a report whose numbers keep advancing is the difference.
Safe to remove at any time. RimDoc+ has a button for it.
